show.description: When your first day at college turns into a battlefield of bullies, betrayal, and blurred lines, how do you fight back? Braced-Up Girl is a fierce ride through the chaos of campus life, self-respect, and the search for identity. This isn’t just a teen drama—it’s Kanika’s war for dignity. Watch Now!
